40011564.author: पदार्थः
40011564.content: महाबलः mighty, सः Hanuman, अनाधृष्यम् inviolable, सागरम् sea, अतिक्रम्य having crossed, स्वस्थः comfortable, त्रिकूटशिखरे on Trikuta mountain peak, स्थिताम् standing, लङ्काम् Lanka, ददर्श ह saw.

40011564.author: Translation
40011564.content: The mighty Hanuman crossed the inviolable sea, stood comfortably on the peak of Trikuta mountain and looked at Lanka.

40011565.author: पदार्थः
40011565.content: ततः then, तत्र there, स्थितः he stood, वीर्यवान् heroic one, पादपमुक्तेन dropped from the trees, पुष्पवर्षेण by the rain of flowers, अभिवृष्टः covered fully, पुष्पमयो यथा like a heap of flowers, बभौ looked.

40011565.author: Translation
40011565.content: Covered fully with the continuous shower of flowers dropped on him from the trees, heroic Hanuman appeared as though he was a heap of flowers as he stood there.

40011566.author: पदार्थः
40011566.content: उत्तमविक्रमः endowed with great prowess, श्रीमान् glorious one, कपिः monkey, योजनानाम् of yojanas, शतम् a hundred, तीर्त्वापि even after crossing also, अनिःश्वसन् without gasping, तत्र there, ग्लानिम् exhaustion, न अधिगच्छति did not experience.

40011566.author: Translation
40011566.content: The glorious, powerful vanara (Hanuman) even after crossing a hundred yojanas, felt neither suffocated nor exasperated.

40011567.author: पदार्थः
40011567.content: अहम् I, योजनानाम् of yojanas, सुबहूनि very many, शतान्यपि even hundreds of them, क्रमेयम् I can cross, शतयोजनम् a hundred yojanas, संख्यातम् a measured, सागरस्य ocean's, अन्तम् end, किं पुनः what more.

40011567.author: Translation
40011567.content: (He said to himself), "I can cross a distance of even hundreds of yojanas. What to say of a hundred yojanas which is a calculated distance."

40011568.author: पदार्थः
40011568.content: वीर्यवताम् courageous, श्रेष्ठः exalted, प्लवतामपि among vanaras, उत्तमः best, सः तु he on his part, वेगवान् noted for speed, महोदधिम् ocean, लङ्घयित्वा after crossing over, लङ्काम् Lanka, जगाम reached.

40011568.author: Translation
40011568.content: Courageous and exalted Hanuman, the best among vanaras, noted for his speed reached Lanka crossing over the great ocean on his own.

40011569.author: पदार्थः
40011569.content: नीलानि darkcoloured, शाद्वलानि having grassland, गन्धवन्ति fragrant, गण्डवन्ति with big rocks, मध्येन on the way, नगवन्ति च mountains also, वनानि च even trees, जगाम went .

40011569.author: Translation
40011569.content: Hanuman passed through forests laden with fragrant flowers, bluish grassy land, big rocks and mountains covered with trees.

40011570.author: पदार्थः
40011570.content: प्लवगर्षभः bull among vanaras, तेजस्वी brilliant one, हनुमान् Hanuman, तरुसंछन्नान् dense with trees, शैलांश्च and mountains, पुष्पिताः blossomed, वनराजीश्च forest ranges, अभिचक्राम crossed.

40011570.author: Translation
40011570.content: Brilliant Hanuman, a bull among monkeys, crossed the mountains covered with blossoming trees and forest ranges.

40011571.author: पदार्थः
40011571.content: सः पवनात्मजः that son of the Windgod, तस्मिन् on that, अचले on the mountain, तिष्ठन् while standing, वनानि forests, उपवनानि च and groves, नगाग्रे on the mountain peaks, ताम् that, लङ्काम् Lanka, ददर्श saw.

40011571.author: Translation
40011571.content: That son of the Windgod stood on the mountain and saw the forests and groves round Lanka situated on the mountain peak.

40011572.author: पदार्थः
40011572.content: कपिकुञ्जरः elephantlike vanara, सरलान् Saralas, कर्णिकारांश्च Karnikaras, सुपुष्पितान् well bloomed, खर्जूरांश्च Datepalms, प्रियालून् Priyala, मुचुलिंदांश्च Muchulinda, कुटजान् Kutaja, केतकानपि and Kethaka, गन्धपूर्णान् filled with fragrance, प्रियङ्गूंश्च Priyangu, नीपान् Nipa, तथा so also, सप्तच्छदान् Saptachhada, आसनान् Asana,  कोविदारांश्च Kovidara, पुष्पितान् flowering, करवीरांश्च Karaveera, पुष्पभारनिबद्धांश्च trees heavily loaded with flowers, तथा so also, मुकुलितानपि and buds, विहगाकीर्णान् filled with birds, पवनाधूतमस्तकान् branches shaken by the wind, पादपान् trees, हंसकारण्डवाकीर्णाः flocks of swans and waterfowls, वापीः ponds, विविधान् different kinds, रम्यान् beautiful, आक्रीडान् pleasure gardens, सर्वर्तुफलपुष्पितैः with a trees yielding fruits and flowers in all seasons, विविधैः with variety of, वृक्षैः trees, सन्ततान् stretched, विविधान् many, जलाशयांश्च water resorts, रम्याणि delightful, उद्यानानि च gardens also, ददर्श saw.

40011572.author: Translation
40011572.content: The mighty vanara saw around Lanka, trees like sarala, karnikara in full bloom, datepalms, priyala, muchulinda, kutaja, kethaka trees filled with fragrance priyangu, kadamba, so also flowering plants like saptachhada, asana, kovidara and karaveera fully loaded with flowers and buds. These trees were thronged by birds, with their branches shaken by the wind. Flocks of swans and waterfowls were found in ponds of different types. There were various pleasure groves with flowers in bloom and fruits of all seasons and varieties of water resorts and delightful gardens.

40011577.author: पदार्थः
40011577.content: लक्ष्मीवान् fortunate, हनुमान् Hanuman, लङ्काम् Lanka, समासाद्य having reached, रावणपालिताम् ruled by Ravana, सपद्माभिः with lotuses, सोत्पलाभिः and blue  lotuses, परिखाभिः by moats, अलङ्कृताम् decorated, सीतापहरणार्थेन keeping Sita's abduction in view, रावणेन by Ravana, समन्तात् all over, विचरद्भि: moving, उग्रधन्विभिः holding frightening bows, राक्षसैः by demons, सुरक्षिताम् well protected, काञ्चनेन with golden, प्राकारेण by boundary wall, आवृताम् surrounded, रम्याम् beautiful, महापुरीम् great city, ग्रहसङ्काशै: resembling the assembly of planets, शारदाम्बुदसन्निभैः resembling autumnal clouds, गृहैश्च houses, पाण्डुराभिः white, उच्चाभिः elevated, प्रतोलीभिः streets, अभिसंवृताम्  crowded,  पताकाध्वजमालिनीम् decorated with banners, flags posts and garlands,दिव्यैः wonderful, काञ्चनैः  golden, लतापङ्त्किविचित्रितैः by rows of colourful creepers, तोरणैः with festoons, दिवि in heaven, देवपुरीमिव like the city of gods, लङ्काम् Lanka, ददर्श saw.

40011577.author: Translation
40011577.content: Fortunate Hanuman having reached Lanka ruled by Ravana found it surrounded by moats full of blue lotuses, guarded by demons with frightening bows, in view of Sita abducted and kept there. It was protected by boundary walls inlaid with gold that great and beautiful city with buildings resembling the assembly of planets and whitewashed, elevated  houses looking like autumnal clouds and well laid out streets decorated with garlands of banners and flag posts, rows of colourful creepers and festoons. The city of Lanka appeared like Amaravati, the city of gods.

40011580.content: लक्ष्मीवान् fortunate, हनुमान् Hanuman, लङ्काम् Lanka, समासाद्य having reached, रावणपालिताम् ruled by Ravana, सपद्माभिः with lotuses, सोत्पलाभिः and blue  lotuses, परिखाभिः by moats, अलङ्कृताम् decorated, सीतापहरणार्थेन keeping Sita's abduction in view, रावणेन by Ravana, समन्तात् all over, विचरद्भि: moving, उग्रधन्विभिः holding frightening bows, राक्षसैः by demons, सुरक्षिताम् well protected, काञ्चनेन with golden, प्राकारेण by boundary wall, आवृताम् surrounded, रम्याम् beautiful, महापुरीम् great city, ग्रहसङ्काशै: resembling the assembly of planets, शारदाम्बुदसन्निभैः resembling autumnal clouds, गृहैश्च houses, पाण्डुराभिः white, उच्चाभिः elevated, प्रतोलीभिः streets, अभिसंवृताम्  crowded,  पताकाध्वजमालिनीम् decorated with banners, flags posts and garlands,दिव्यैः wonderful, काञ्चनैः  golden, लतापङ्त्किविचित्रितैः by rows of colourful creepers, तोरणैः with festoons, दिवि in heaven, देवपुरीमिव like the city of gods, लङ्काम् Lanka, ददर्श saw.

40011580.author: Translation
40011580.content: Fortunate Hanuman having reached Lanka ruled by Ravana found it surrounded by moats full of blue lotuses, guarded by demons with frightening bows, in view of Sita abducted and kept there. It was protected by boundary walls inlaid with gold that great and beautiful city with buildings resembling the assembly of planets and whitewashed, elevated  houses looking like autumnal clouds and well laid out streets decorated with garlands of banners and flag posts, rows of colourful creepers and festoons. The city of Lanka appeared like Amaravati, the city of gods.

40011582.author: पदार्थः
40011582.content: सः that, कपिश्रेष्ठः foremost of the vanaras, पाण्डुरैः with white , शुभैः with auspicious, भवनैः with mansions, गिरिमूर्ध्नि  on the mountain, स्थिताम् stood, आकाशगम् यथा as if touching the sky, पुरं a city, लङ्काम् Lanka, ददर्श saw.

40011582.author: Translation
40011582.content: The foremost among the vanaras, perched on top of the mountain saw the city of Lanka on the mountain with auspicious mansions as though touching the sky.

40011583.author: पदार्थः
40011583.content: हनुमान् Hanuman, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by the lord of demons, पालिताम् ruled, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, निर्मिताम् constructed, आकाशे in the sky, प्लवमानामिव as if moving  पुरीम् city, ददर्श saw.

40011583.author: Translation
40011583.content: The city of Lanka, ruled by the lord of demons and built by Visvakarma looked as if it was a city floating in the sky.

40011584.author: पदार्थः
40011584.content: वानरः vanara, वप्रप्राकारजघनाम् ramparts of the fortress for hips and loins, विपुलाम्बुनवाम्बराम् moats full of water for robes, शतघ्नीशूलकेशान्ताम् spiked iron tridents for locks of hair, अट्टालकवतंसकाम् tall towers for earrings, मनसा  in the mind, एव only, कृतां conceived, निर्मिताम् built, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, लङ्काम् Lanka, उत्तरं द्वारम् northern entrance, आसाद्य having reached, चिन्तयामास started thinking.

40011584.author: Translation
40011584.content: Having reached the northern entrance of the city he started thinking that Visvakarma must have conceived Lanka as a lady with its ramparts as her hips and loins, moats filled with water as her robes, the spiked iron tridents as her locks of hair, and the tall towers as her her ear rings

40011585.author: पदार्थः
40011585.content: वानरः vanara, वप्रप्राकारजघनाम् ramparts of the fortress for hips and loins, विपुलाम्बुनवाम्बराम् moats full of water for robes, शतघ्नीशूलकेशान्ताम् spiked iron tridents for locks of hair, अट्टालकवतंसकाम् tall towers for earrings, मनसा  in the mind, एव only, कृतां conceived, निर्मिताम् built, विश्वकर्मणा by Visvakarma, लङ्काम् Lanka, उत्तरं द्वारम् northern entrance, आसाद्य having reached, चिन्तयामास started thinking.

40011585.author: Translation
40011585.content: Having reached the northern entrance of the city he started thinking that Visvakarma must have conceived Lanka as a lady with its ramparts as her hips and loins, moats filled with water as her robes, the spiked iron tridents as her locks of hair, and the tall towers as her her ear rings

40011586.author: पदार्थः
40011586.content: कैलासशिखरप्रख्याम् resembling mount Kailas, अम्बरम् sky, अलिखन्तीमिव as if scraping, उच्छ्रितैः by raised skyscrapers, भवनोत्तमैः by excellent mansions, आकाशम् sky, डीयमानामिव like flying in the air, नागैः by nagas, भोगवतीमिव like Bhogavati the nether world, घोरैः with dreadful, राक्षसैः demons, सम्पूर्णाम् totally, अचिन्त्याम् unimaginable, सुकृताम् wellbuilt, स्पष्टाम् clearly visible, पुरा earlier, कुबेराध्युषिताम् occupied by Kubera, आशीविषैः by venemous serpents, गुहामिव like a cave, दंष्ट्रिभिः having protruding fangs, शूरैः by warriors, शूलपट्टसपाणिभिः by those holding tridents and spears in their hands, घोरैः  horrible, राक्षसैः by demons, रक्षिताम् guarded, सः वानरः that vanara, तस्याः her, महतीम् great, गुप्तिं security, सागरं च even the ocean, घोरम् रिपुम् terrific enemy, रावणं च Ravana also, निरीक्ष्य looked at, चिन्तयामास started thinking.

40011586.author: Translation
40011586.content: Observing Lanka that resembled mount Kailas, with sky scrapers appearing as if flying, filled with dreadful demons and nagas protecting the city of Bhogavati (the city of Patala), unimaginably wellbuilt. It was once occupied by Kubera (half brother of Ravana). It was guarded by horrible demons holding tridents and spears in their hands. The city appeared like a cavern protected by venomous serpents with protruding fangs. Hanuman examined the high security of Lanka and looked at the ocean. He thought of the form of Ravana, a formidable  enemy:

40011587.author: पदार्थः
40011587.content: कैलासशिखरप्रख्याम् resembling mount Kailas, अम्बरम् sky, अलिखन्तीमिव as if scraping, उच्छ्रितैः by raised skyscrapers, भवनोत्तमैः by excellent mansions, आकाशम् sky, डीयमानामिव like flying in the air, नागैः by nagas, भोगवतीमिव like Bhogavati the nether world, घोरैः with dreadful, राक्षसैः demons, सम्पूर्णाम् totally, अचिन्त्याम् unimaginable, सुकृताम् wellbuilt, स्पष्टाम् clearly visible, पुरा earlier, कुबेराध्युषिताम् occupied by Kubera, आशीविषैः by venemous serpents, गुहामिव like a cave, दंष्ट्रिभिः having protruding fangs, शूरैः by warriors, शूलपट्टसपाणिभिः by those holding tridents and spears in their hands, घोरैः  horrible, राक्षसैः by demons, रक्षिताम् guarded, सः वानरः that vanara, तस्याः her, महतीम् great, गुप्तिं security, सागरं च even the ocean, घोरम् रिपुम् terrific enemy, रावणं च Ravana also, निरीक्ष्य looked at, चिन्तयामास started thinking.

40011589.content: कैलासशिखरप्रख्याम् resembling mount Kailas, अम्बरम् sky, अलिखन्तीमिव as if scraping, उच्छ्रितैः by raised skyscrapers, भवनोत्तमैः by excellent mansions, आकाशम् sky, डीयमानामिव like flying in the air, नागैः by nagas, भोगवतीमिव like Bhogavati the nether world, घोरैः with dreadful, राक्षसैः demons, सम्पूर्णाम् totally, अचिन्त्याम् unimaginable, सुकृताम् wellbuilt, स्पष्टाम् clearly visible, पुरा earlier, कुबेराध्युषिताम् occupied by Kubera, आशीविषैः by venemous serpents, गुहामिव like a cave, दंष्ट्रिभिः having protruding fangs, शूरैः by warriors, शूलपट्टसपाणिभिः by those holding tridents and spears in their hands, घोरैः  horrible, राक्षसैः by demons, रक्षिताम् guarded, सः वानरः that vanara, तस्याः her, महतीम् great, गुप्तिं security, सागरं च even the ocean, घोरम् रिपुम् terrific enemy, रावणं च Ravana also, निरीक्ष्य looked at, चिन्तयामास started thinking.

40011589.content: Observing Lanka that resembled mount Kailas, with sky scrapers appearing as if flying, filled with dreadful demons and nagas protecting the city of Bhogavati (the city of Patala), unimaginably wellbuilt. It was once occupied by Kubera (half brother of Ravana). It was guarded by horrible demons holding tridents and spears in their hands. The city appeared like a cavern protected by venomous serpents with protruding fangs. Hanuman examined the high security of Lanka and looked at the ocean. He thought of the form of Ravana, a formidable  enemy:

40011590.author: पदार्थः
40011590.content: हरयः monkeys, इह here, आगत्यापि even after coming here, निरर्थकाः will not serve any purpose, भविष्यन्ति will be, लङ्का Lanka, युद्धेन by war, सुरैरपि even by gods, जेतुम् to win, न शक्या हि not possible.

40011590.author: Translation
40011590.content: 'It is not possible for monkeys to come here and even if they do, it is no use. Lanka is invincible even to the gods in war.

40011591.author: पदार्थः
40011591.content: विषमाम् most difficult, दुर्गाम् formidable, रावणपालिताम् ruled by Ravana, इमाम् this, लङ्काम् Lanka, प्राप्यापि even if he comes, महाबाहुः greatarmed, सः राघवः that Rama, किं करिष्यति what can he do?

40011591.author: Translation
40011591.content: 'What will  Rama the mighty armed hero do even after reaching this formidable city of Lanka ruled by Ravana?

40011592.author: पदार्थः
40011592.content: राक्षसेषु with demons, सान्त्वस्य for reconciliation, अवकाशः scope, न अभिगम्यते not expected, दानस्य by making offers, न not, भेदस्य  by dissension, न not, युद्धस्य of war, नैव दृश्यते not feasible.

40011592.author: Translation
40011592.content: 'There is no scope for reconciliation with the demons. It is not possible to win over them with gifts. They cannot be divided by dissension. There is no scope for war.

40011593.author: पदार्थः
40011593.content: वालिपुत्रस्य Vali's son's, नीलस्य of Nila, मम mine, धीमतः of the wise one, राज्ञश्च king's, महात्मनाम् of the great souls, चतुर्णाम् of these four, वानराणाम् these four among vanaras only, गतिः हि can come here.

40011593.author: Translation
40011593.content: 'Only four great monkeys can have access to this place. They are Angada the son of Vali, Nila, Sugriva, the wise king of monkeys and myself.

40011594.author: पदार्थः
40011594.content: वैदेहीम् Vaidehi, यदि जीवति वा if she is alive or, न वा not alive, यावत् जानामि until I know, ताम् her, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, तत्रैव there on the spot, चिन्तयिष्यामि I shall think over.

40011594.author: Translation
40011594.content: 'Whether Janaka's daughter, Vaidehi is alive or not is not known. After seeing her I shall think over'.

40011595.author: पदार्थः
40011595.content: ततः then, रामस्य Rama's, अभ्युदये in his welfare, रतः lay, सः that, कपिकुञ्जरः elephant among vanaras, तस्मिन् on that, गिरिशृङ्गे on the mountain peak, स्थितः stood, मुहूर्तम् for a short while, चिन्तयामास  pondered.

40011595.author: Translation
40011595.content: Standing on the mountain, the elephant among monkeys pondered for a while on the means of finding Sita, in which lay the welfare of Rama.

40011596.author: पदार्थः
40011596.content: क्रूरैः by the fierce, बलसमन्वितैः by the powerful ones, राक्षसैः by demons, गुप्ता guarded, रक्षसाम् of demons, पुरी city, मया by me, अनेन by this present, रूपेण form, प्रवेष्टुम् to enter, न शक्या not possible.

40011596.author: Translation
40011596.content: 'I shall not be able  in my present form to enter the city guarded by fierce and powerful demons.

40011597.author: पदार्थः
40011597.content: जानकीम् Sita, परिमार्गता while searching, मया by me, उग्रौजसः energetic, महावीर्याः very valiant, बलवन्तश्च powerful, राक्षसाः demons, सर्वे all, वञ्चनीयाः should be deceived.

40011597.author: Translation
40011597.content: While searching for Janaki, all the demons—fierce, mighty and powerful—must be eluded by me.

40011598.author: पदार्थः
40011598.content: मे for me, महत् great, कृत्यम् task, साधयितुम् to accomplish, मया by me, लक्ष्यालक्ष्येण in a non conspicious, रूपेण form, रात्रौ during night, लङ्कापुरी city of Lanka, प्रवेष्टुम् to enter, प्राप्तकालम् is the appropriate time.

40011598.author: Translation
40011598.content: 'To accomplish this great task I will have to assume an inconspicious form and enter the city of Lanka in the night as that is the appropriate time.

40011599.author: पदार्थः
40011599.content: हनुमान् Hanuman, सुरासुरैः by gods and demons, दुराधर्षाम् unassailable, तादृशीम् such, ताम् that, पुरीम् city, दृष्ट्वा seeing, विनिश्चित्य sighing, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, चिन्तयामास reflected.

40011599.author: Translation
40011599.content: 'Looking at the city, unassailable even to gods and demons, Hanuman sighed again and again thinking:

40011600.author: पदार्थः
40011600.content: दुरात्मना evilminded, राक्षसेन्द्रेण by lord of demons, रावणेन by Ravana, अदृष्टः without being seen, केन for that, उपायेन means, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter, मैथिलीम् Mythili, पश्येयम् will be possible to find.

40011600.author: Translation
40011600.content: 'By what means can I find Mythili, daughter of Janaka, without being noticed by the evilminded Ravana, the lord of demons?

40011601.author: पदार्थः
40011601.content: विदितात्मनः one who is endowed with selfknowledge, रामस्य Rama's, कार्यम् task, कथम् how, न विनश्येत् will not be spoilt, एकश्च single person, रहिते in a private audience, एकाम् her, जनकात्मजाम् Sita, पश्येयम् possible to see.

40011601.author: Translation
40011601.content: 'How can the purpose of Rama, a noble soul be not spoilt? I may have a private audience with the daughter of Janaka.

40011602.author: पदार्थः
40011602.content: विक्लबम् one who has no sense, दूतम् messenger, आसाद्य is after getting, देशकालविरोधिताः set in opposition to proper time and place, भूताः it plan, अर्था: the planned strategies, सूर्योदये at the time of Sunrise, तमः यथा like darkness, विपद्यन्ते will be destroyed.

40011602.author: Translation
40011602.content: 'Just as darkness disappears at Sunrise, wellplanned strategies also fail at the hands of a thoughtless messenger when they are set in opposition to proper time and place.

40011603.author: पदार्थः
40011603.content: निश्चिता अपि even though decided, बुद्धि: intelligent, अर्थानर्थान्तरे  between a proper course of action and inaction, न शोभते not look nice, पण्डितमानिनः clever and capable, दूताः messengers, कार्याणि efforts, घातयन्ति हि will spoil.

40011603.author: Translation
40011603.content: 'Even though messengers are not intelligent, they think themselves clever and capable. They act foolishly, swerve from proper course of action and fail in their effort.

40011604.author: पदार्थः
40011604.content: कार्यम्  effort, कथम् how, विनश्येत्  not be destroyed, वैक्लब्यम् thoughtlessness, कथम् how, न भवेत् will not be, समुद्रस्य ocean's, लङ्घनं च croosing, कथं नु how indeed, वृथा waste, न भवेत् not become?

40011604.author: Translation
40011604.content: 'How should the task be performed? How to avoid impetuousness? How can my purpose of crossing the ocean be not wasted?

40011605.author: पदार्थः
40011605.content: मयि I am, रक्षोभिः by the demons, दृष्टे तु seen, रावणानर्थम् destruction of  Ravana, इच्छतः desiring, विदितात्मनः divine knowledge, रामस्य Rama's, इदम् this, कार्यम् plan, व्यर्थम् wasted, भवेत् will be.

40011605.author: Translation
40011605.content: 'If I am seen by the demons, the plan of Rama, possessor of selfknowledge, to kill Ravana, will be wasted.

40011606.author: पदार्थः
40011606.content: राक्षसैः by demons, अविज्ञातेन without being identified, राक्षसरूपेणापि even by assuming the form of a demon, क्वचित् anywhere, स्थातुम् to stay with them, न शक्यं हि  not be possible, अन्येन in other form, केनचित् by any form, किमुत what to say.

40011606.author: Translation
40011606.content: 'It is difficult to stay with the demon anywhere here even in the disguise of a demon without being identified. It will not be possible to remain unidentified even by assuming any other form.

40011607.author: पदार्थः
40011607.content: अत्र here, वायुरपि even wind, अज्ञातः without being detected, न चरेत् may not move, इति thus, मम my, मतिः thought, बलीयसाम् the powerful, राक्षसानाम् of demons, अविदितं unknown, किञ्चित् even a little indeed, नास्ति हि not.

40011607.author: Translation
40011607.content: 'I think even the wind who has no form cannot move here without being detected. Nothing escapes the notice of powerful demons. There is nothing unknown to them.

40011608.author: पदार्थः
40011608.content: अहम् I, स्वेन with my own, रूपेण with form, संवृतः hidden, इह here, तिष्ठामि यदि if I stay, विनाशम् death, उपयास्यामि will befall me, भर्तुः lord, अर्थश्च work also, हीयते will fail.

40011608.author: Translation
40011608.content: 'I will surely meet with death if I hide here in my original form and my master's mission also will be spoilt.

40011609.author: पदार्थः
40011609.content: तत् therefore, अहम् I, स्वेन रूपेण in my own form, ह्रस्वताम् in a tiny form, गतः assuming, राघवस्य Rama's, अर्थसिद्धये to accomplish, रजन्याम् in the night, लङ्काम् Lanka, अभिपतिष्यामि I shall jump.

40011609.author: Translation
40011609.content: 'Therefore I shall transform myself into a tiny form and jump about the city of Lanka during night time in order to accomplish Raghava's purpose.

40011610.author: पदार्थः
40011610.content: सुदुरासदाम् quite inaccessible, पुरीम् city, रात्रौ at night, प्रविश्य after entering, रावणस्य Ravana's, सर्वम् all, भवनम् palace, विचिन्वन् search all over, जनकात्मजाम् Janaka's daughter, Sita, द्रक्ष्यामि I will see.

40011610.author: Translation
40011610.content: 'Entering by night the inaccessible city of Ravana, I shall search all over the palace and find Sita'.

40011611.author: पदार्थः
40011611.content: वीरः कपिः heroic vanara, हनुमान् Hanuman, इति thus, सञ्चिन्त्य after thinking, वैदेह्याः Vaidehi's, दर्शनोत्सुकः keen to see, तदा then, सूर्यस्य Sun's, अस्तमयम् setting time, आचकाङ्क्षे looked forward.

40011611.author: Translation
40011611.content: Having planned in that manner the heroic Hanuman keen to see Sita waited for the Sunset.

40011612.author: पदार्थः
40011612.content: सूर्ये when the Sun, अस्तंगते च set, मारुतिः son of the windgod Maruti, रात्रौ in the night, देहम् body, सङ्क्षिप्य after reducing to small size, पृषदंशकमात्रः सन् not bigger than the size of a cat, अद्भुतदर्शनः wonderful to behold, बभूव appeared.

40011612.author: Translation
40011612.content: When Sun set, Maruti, the son of the Windgod, reduced himself at night to the small size of a cat, wonderful to behold.

40011613.author: पदार्थः
40011613.content: वीर्यवान् courageous, हनुमान् Hanuman, प्रदोषकाले at dusk, तूर्णम् at once, उत्ल्पुत्य jumped, सुविभक्तमहापथाम् a place well laidoutgreat royal path, रम्याम् beautiful, पुरीम् city, प्रविवेश entered.

40011613.author: Translation
40011613.content: As soon as dusk had set in, courageous Hanuman jumped in and entered the well laidout royal path of the beautiful city.

40011614.author: पदार्थः
40011614.content: सः that, प्रासादमालावितताम् stretched with a row of mansions, काञ्चनराजतैः with gold and silver, स्तम्भैः with pillars, शातकुम्भमयैः made of gold, जालैः fretwork, गन्धर्वनगरोपमाम् resembling the city of gandharvas, सप्तभौमाष्टभौमैः च seven and eight storied mansions, स्फाटिकसंकीर्णैः inlaid with crystals, कार्तस्वरविभूषितैः decorated with gold, तलैः floors, महापुरीम्  the grand city, ददर्श saw.

40011614.author: Translation
40011614.content: Hanuman saw the city stretched with rows of buildings all over,with seven or eight storied  mansions, which had pillars of gold and silver, windows with fretwork of gold, inlaid with crystals, floors decorated with gold, resembling the grand city of gandharvas.

40011615.author: पदार्थः
40011615.content: सः that, प्रासादमालावितताम् stretched with a row of mansions, काञ्चनराजतैः with gold and silver, स्तम्भैः with pillars, शातकुम्भमयैः made of gold, जालैः fretwork, गन्धर्वनगरोपमाम् resembling the city of gandharvas, सप्तभौमाष्टभौमैः च seven and eight storied mansions, स्फाटिकसंकीर्णैः inlaid with crystals, कार्तस्वरविभूषितैः decorated with gold, तलैः floors, महापुरीम्  the grand city, ददर्श saw.

40011615.author: Translation
40011615.content: Hanuman saw the city stretched with rows of buildings all over,with seven or eight storied  mansions, which had pillars of gold and silver, windows with fretwork of gold, inlaid with crystals, floors decorated with gold, resembling the grand city of gandharvas.

40011616.author: पदार्थः
40011616.content: अत्र here, रक्षसाम् of demons, भवनानि mansions, वैडूर्यमणिचित्रैः  inlaid with precious gems, मुक्ताजालविभूषितैः fretwork ornamented with pearls, तलैः with floors, शुशुभिरे looked splendid.

40011616.author: Translation
40011616.content: Inlaid with precious gems and fretwork, and ornamented with pearls, the mansions of demons looked splendid.

40011617.author: पदार्थः
40011617.content: रक्षसाम् of demons, काञ्चनानि golden ones, चित्राणि colourful ones, तोरणानि archways, समलङ्कृताम् decorated all over, लङ्काम् Lanka, सर्वतः everywhere, उद्योतयामासुः illumined.

40011617.author: Translation
40011617.content: The golden archways of the demon were colourful. They illuminated the well   decorated Lanka from all sides.

40011618.author: पदार्थः
40011618.content: महाकपिः great vanara, अचिन्त्याम् unimaginable, अद्भुताकाराम् wonderful, लङ्काम् Lanka, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, वैदेह्याः Vaidehi's, दर्शनोत्सुकः eager to see, विषण्णः sad, हृष्टश्च and glad, आसीत् became.

40011618.author: Translation
40011618.content: Beholding Lanka of unimaginable, wonderful glory, the great monkey keen to see Sita became sad as well as elated at once (He did not know how to find Sita in that city and felt sad. But he was also elated that he was going to meet her at any cost.)

40011619.author: पदार्थः
40011619.content: पाण्डुराविद्धविमानमालिनीम् a city having a garland of white mansions with several floors, महार्हजाम्बूनदजालतोरणाम् the archways and windows latticed with gold strings, यशस्विनीम्  famed, भीमबलैः by warriors of terrific strength, क्षपाचरैः by demons, समावृताम् surrounded, रावणबाहुपालिताम् ruled by Ravana.

40011619.author: Translation
40011619.content: He found that famed place with a garland of tall, white mansions, conspicuous with archways latticed with gold strings, protected by mighty Ravana and surrounded by terrific demons.

40011620.author: पदार्थः
40011620.content: नैकसहस्ररश्मि: having thousands of rays, चन्द्रोऽपि even the Moon, तारागणैः with multitude of stars, मध्यगतः came in the centre, विराजन् illumining, लोकम् the world, ज्योत्स्नावितानेन with a canopy of moonlight, वितत्य having expanded, अस्य his, साचिव्यम् ministerial assistance, कुर्वन्निव as if to render, उत्तिष्ठते rises.

40011620.author: Translation
40011620.content: Even the Moon rose with thousands of rays in the centre of multitudes of stars overspreading and illumining the world with a canopy of bright beams, as if to render ministerial help to Hanuman.

40011621.author: पदार्थः
40011621.content: सः हरिप्रवीरः that heroic vanara, उद्गच्छमानम् rising up and looking, शङ्खप्रभम् shining like the white conch, व्यवभासमानम् hiding and coming out, क्षीरमृणालवर्णम् like the colur of milk and lotus stalks, सरसि a lake, पोप्लूयमानम् floating, हंसमिव like a swan, चन्द्रम् the Moon, ददर्श saw.

40011621.author: Translation
40011621.content: The heroic vanara saw the rising Moon flitting in and out shining like a fresh white conch, in the colour of milk and lotus stalks, bright like a swan floating in the lakelike sky. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे द्वितीयस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the second sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
